hero.title: Support & Contact
hero.lede: Donate, pick up some merch, or get in touch — every bit helps keep Kent's legacy alive.

donate.heading: Donate today to help us preserve and promote Texas Music
donate.text: Click below to make a one-time or recurring donation through PayPal. We know these are trying times economically for everyone — thank you so much for your generosity and for helping us continue to provide a place for Texas songwriters to learn and grow.

merch.heading: Merchandise
merch.text: Foundation t-shirts, hats, and other gear are available — every purchase directly supports the Songwriter Circle and our education programs.

membership.heading: Guidestar / Candid Profile
membership.text: The Cheatham Street Music Foundation is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit. Our Guidestar/Candid profile has our financials and transparency information for donors.

contact.heading: Get in Touch
contact.note: For booking, press, or general Foundation questions, reach out by phone or email. For nightly show times, check the Weekly Early Shows and Songwriter Circle listings on the Programs & Events page.
